params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating a list box (command applies to the row) or a list box column (command applies to the cell at the column/row intersection).

params.name: row
params.description: Number of the row to apply the style to (hidden/shown row state is not taken into account).

params.name: style
params.description: Font style constant, or a bitwise combination of constants, from the Font Styles theme.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the font style of a row, or of a single cell, in an array-type list box.

constraints: This command only works with array-type list boxes.
Style arrays for columns take priority over style arrays for the list box: applying this command to the whole list box only has an effect if no style array has been assigned to the columns.
